capabilities: Open .yaml and .yml files in a dedicated view
Show maps, sequences, scalars, aliases, comments and parse errors as a tree
Filter tree nodes by key, value or YAML path
Navigate large files with a right-side outline
Copy raw YAML or individual YAML paths
extras: Read-only by design: it never writes to YAML files, makes no network requests, and touches the clipboard only when a copy button is clicked. The README also documents a BRAT beta install and the release process.
motivation: YAML files often contain comments, anchors, ordering and formatting that matter, and a form editor can easily reserialize YAML and damage those details.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse YAML files as structured data, and form-based editors risk reserializing them and losing comments, anchors and ordering.
summary: Read-only viewer that opens .yaml and .yml files as a collapsible tree with filtering, an outline panel and syntax-highlighted source.
